verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it can tackle Linear/Jira tickets, and its CLI's MCP support explicitly lists issue trackers among the external services it can connect to. However, there is no detailed first-party documentation of a Jira or Linear integration or of the ticket-management actions agents can take. Missing for 10: documented native Jira/Linear connector setup, any ClickUp or Monday.com support, explicit ticket create/update/manage capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly

citations.quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets
MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets you connect external tool servers to Devin CLI, giving the agent access to APIs, databases, issue trackers, and any other service you can wrap in an MCP server.
